notes.title: Pinnacle Point Demo is Coming Soon (Streamers Can Contact Me for Early Access)
notes.notes:
A lot has been happening behind the scenes, and I wanted to take a moment to say thanks. The support, feedback, and excitement for Pinnacle Point have been incredible, and I've been hard at work making sure the demo delivers.

If everything goes as planned, the [b]DEMO [/b]should be out around [b]April or early May.[/b] I'll have more details soon, but one thing's for sure—the island won't stay quiet forever.

For streamers and content creators: I'll be sending out early access keys for the demo ahead of launch. If you want to be first in line, email me at cagedelephant666@gmail.com to get on the waiting list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920948/da08b4a5282faf823a7d1b92ac4df15dab77ea5f.png[/img]

In the meantime, wishlist Pinnacle Point on Steam, spread the word, and stay tuned. Things are moving.

- Robin

PS: I've updated the store page with a new Gameplay Teaser Trailer and a few new screenshots, showcasing the latest state of the game—check it out!

notes.title: Check out the PSX vibes on spooky, lo-fi horror mystery Pinnacle Point
notes.notes: n upcoming indie horror game has pretty promising vibes and the look that I know some of us love to see in a horror title. Pinnacle Point by solo developer Robin Shen, aka Ready2Run, is all kinds of fog and neon and blocky polygons that encapsulate the lo-fi vibe of the PSX era of gaming... Read more.
